name: Nívar (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Nívar (a castle on red and a cross above a mountain on blue).
history: Nívar adopted its arms and flag officially on 16 December 2005; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 2:3, divided horizontally into two stripes of equal size, white above and red below, with the municipal arms superimposed at the centre of the cloth.

features.role: Nívar arms — castle and cross above a mountain
